measured_boundary.name: Static Entry Mathematics
measured_boundary.statement: Within Information Class IC-001 (static entry-time OHLCV-derived information), no practically useful outcome discrimination was observed on the certified XAUUSD corpus under the evaluated research conditions.
measured_boundary.statement_short: Static entry-state morphology derived from OHLCV did not discriminate outcomes on the XAUUSD frozen-candidate corpus.
measured_surfaces: engine scores (CRT / RR / Gaussian / Zone / Fusion)
morphology clusters (KMeans on dimensionless shape features)
measured_boundary.result: no practically useful outcome separation: engine AUC~0.49-0.51; cluster outcomes ~uniform (SL 66-68% / TP 31-33%); k-NN concordance (0.5498) ~= random (0.5459); TS-CV OOF~0.51-0.52 after removing shuffle inflation; dual-read bar 78 constructive counterexample
measured_boundary.explicitly_not: This does NOT show that OTHER information classes are uninformative — those are UNMEASURED (below). 'Not measured' != 'likely to work' and != 'shown to be uninformative'. Does NOT archive entry research forever — only IC-001 on this corpus.
